title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
tagline: Electro and a goblin, in the Webb films’ New York.
summary: The sequel tie-in follows The Amazing Spider-Man 2, with Electro and Harry Osborn’s Goblin among the threats. Beenox developed it for Activision. It is not the Insomniac series that arrived four years later.
gameplay: Open-world swinging and combat on the main platforms, retelling pieces of the film and adding gang territories.
